newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mesirow lowers Woodhead.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mesirow lowers Woodhead.

text.p: - Mesirow Financial said it lowered its rating on Woodhead Industries Inc to buy from focus buy, and trimmed estimates for fiscal 1997 earnings due to a higher than expected tax rate and continued sluggishness in domestic markets for the company's electrical equipment products.

- Mesirow analyst Gary Prestopino said he lowered his fiscal 1997 earnings estimate to a range of $1.02 to $1.05 a share from $1.11. His estimate for Woodhead's fiscal year ending September 30, 1996, is unchanged at $0.97.
- Prestopino said he had upgraded Woodhead to Mesirow's focus list on July 1 after the stock had declined 19 percent in price when the company was deleted from the Russell 2000 Index.
- Woodhead shares were trading at 12-7/8 off 3/8.
